items.closes: Answering resolves the item and closes its hold when the question blocks. The hold is null for a question that does not block (AP-3). Cancelling the task or deleting its content also resolves the item.

items.prd_choices: Approve the action, or stop it.

Waive the action, return the task for rework (only while no action has been announced as started or reported done), or cancel. When a rule check stopped the action: override that check once, which approves the action.
Offer the task again to the same builder, mark the action done, waive it, or cancel.
Allow one more round, edit the contract, or cancel. One more round closes the hold, and the next failure opens it again.
Edit the contract, override the check once, turn the rule off, or cancel.
Override the check once, edit the contract, or cancel.
Run it again, override it once, or turn the rule off.
Mark the access granted, or cancel.
Change the budget, or resume the project.
Sign in again. It opens the provider's own sign-in window.
items.closes: When this item’s credential is verified or its hold closes. A reading that restores a signed-in candidate closes the hold and resolves its item at the reading command time.

items.prd_choices: None. It closes when a reading shows capacity.
items.closes: When a new ok reading shows capacity in every window refused since the current limit began. When any refusal named no window the reading must also show room in every limit figure and include at least one (milestone 6 plan CR-14). A passed Verify or Sign in again of the credential still clears a limit with no reset time (milestone 3 plan HE-2). The item is also resolved when its hold has a reset time to wait for again (milestone 6 plan CR-28).

items.prd_choices: Connect an agent from another provider, or turn the provider rule off. It closes on its own when a connected seat may review the task.
items.closes: On its own when a connected seat may review the task (L200, plan SM-42).

items.prd_choices: None. It closes on its own when a seat with the role polls again.

role.description: The role that is offline. planner is never written: no item opens for an offline planner (DB-31; milestone 4 plan RD-20).

waiting_checks.description: Rule check and approval jobs queued and not claimed, plus checks held with check_error, counted by the read each time: the count now, not the count when the item opened (milestone 4 plan RD-18).

items.closes: On its own when a seat with the role polls again (L201, L402), and not before. A check waits for the orchestrator while its rule_check or approval job is queued or while it is held with check_error. A General seat counts for the orchestrator's presence while it has polled in the last 90 seconds and holds an orchestrator job, or holds nothing and, for a waiting check, could claim it (Jobs.next_for), as a new attempt when the check is held with check_error, or holds nothing while no check waits (GA-6). It opens only while at least one rule_check or approval job is queued or one check is held with check_error (L401; milestone 4 plan RD-16).

items.prd_item: A task an agent added needs its contract
items.prd_choices: Complete the contract, ask a planner to draft it, or cancel. It closes when the task's contract changes, or when the task is cancelled.

seat_id.description: The seat that added the task (its task.created actor).

items.closes: With the contract_incomplete hold it was opened beside: on the next task.contract_changed (the owner's Complete contract or Edit contract, or a planner's draft), or when the task is cancelled. inbox.resolved carries complete_contract for the owner's Complete contract, draft_contract for a planner's draft (only the owner's Draft contract queues one), cancel for Cancel, and null for Edit contract (HE-29). The app opens it when a contract_incomplete hold opens on a task whose task.created actor is a seat (UX-16); the owner's own Add task shows the failure on its form and opens none.

items.prd_choices: None. It closes on its own when fewer than 50 tasks that agents added are open.
items.closes: On its own when fewer than 50 open tasks (not Done and not Cancelled) were added by a seat, checked by the sweep and after every task.done and task.cancelled. It opens when an agent's Add task is refused with add_task_limit because 50 are open, if it is not open already (UX-14).
